---
title: "Zindan Se Chutke Abid e Bemaar"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

karbala aagaye sadaat

uthiye hussain aap ke zawwar aaye hai

zindan se chutke abid e bemaar aaye hai

bhoole nahi hai sham aur koofe ke raaste

tarse huwe hai maula ye matam ke waaste

sab kuch lutaake aao ke ghamkhar aaye hai

zainab ne chalte naaqe se khud ko gira diya

phir koniyo se chal ke gayi bhai se kaha

hum log hoke kooch o bazaar aaye hai

gardan pe aur jism pe zanjeer ke nishan

ek ek zakhm dard ki kehta hai daastan

zindan se zinda laut ke lachaar aaye hai

jee khol kar yahan tera matam karenge hum

karbobala may majlise chehlum karenge hum

ay maula sham waale azadaar aaye hai

zindan may ek teri azadar reh gayi

karbobala na aayi na zindan se ghar gayi

dafna ke usko abid e bemaar aaye hai

zindan may karke aaya hai majlis ye kaarwan

sab bibiyan thi matami zainab thi nohakhwan

mehre khuda o deedaye khoon baar aaye hai

kaisa safar batool ki beti ne tay kiya

dete nahi they aseeron ko raasta

tay kar ki saari manzilein dushwaar aayi hai

be-dard thay wo sham aur koofe ke sab makeen

tang hogayi thi aale mohamed pe ye zameen

sadaat hoke jeene se be-zaar aaye hai

farhan o mazhar abdi kyun na ho nauhagar

sajjad chut ke qaid se baba ki qabr par

lekar nishane tauq e garabaar aaye hai

zindan se chutke…
